features_note: the inputs the members read, as of the decision instant, plus the as-of scarcity state; the stack adds no other input
calibration: isotonic recalibration of the stack's probability on the training window's walk-forward stack probabilities, refitted every 21 scored days (the same stack as calibrated_stack_logistic); metadata/calibrated_stack.json: the five passers' probabilities and one indicator per as-of reserve-scarcity state (0, 1, 2, 3, none), ridge towards the equal-weight pool, refitted every 21 scored days on earlier outcomes; metadata/hindsight_regimes.json, followed by the isotonic step of metadata/calibrated_stack.json
